Deseable: experiencia en mitigación de GEI en sectores como eficiencia energética, energías renovables, soluciones basadas en la naturaleza, gestión de residuos o movilidad sostenible. Registrar las iniciativas de mitigación mencionadas por los participantes como punto de partida del diagnóstico. Diagnóstico de iniciativas (meses 3 y 4) Identificar iniciativas de mitigación existentes o en formulación a partir de fuentes secundarias, de los talleres y de las iniciativas remitidas por el Profesional de Apoyo Territorial. Recopilar, como mínimo, la siguiente información de cada iniciativa: Información general, ubicación y área de intervención, cuando aplique. Sector, actividad de mitigación y estado de avance. Objetivos, actores involucrados y población beneficiaria. Potencial o contribución esperada a la mitigación de GEI. Capacidades técnicas y financieras existentes y necesidades de fortalecimiento. Riesgos, barreras y oportunidades. Revisar la consistencia de la información sobre potencial de mitigación y señalar al Especialista en mitigación de GEI los casos que requieran validación. Apoyo al proceso de selección (meses 5 y 6) Apoyar la recepción y organización de la documentación de postulantes. Realizar la revisión preliminar de requisitos documentales mediante listas de chequeo. Apoyar la organización de expedientes. Preparar la información de soporte para las matrices de evaluación, sin asignar puntajes ni participar en las decisiones de selección. Coordinar entrevistas o visitas cuando sean requeridas. Documentar evidencias y observaciones. Acompañamiento y seguimiento de las iniciativas piloto (meses 6 a 9) Una vez seleccionadas las dos (2) iniciativas piloto: Apoyar a las iniciativas en la estructuración de sus planes de trabajo, cronogramas, presupuestos e instrumentos de seguimiento, conforme a los formatos definidos por el equipo principal. Identificar dificultades, riesgos y necesidades de acompañamiento. Recopilar evidencias fotográficas y documentales cuando corresponda. Aplicar los instrumentos de seguimiento y preparar reportes de visita. Alertar oportunamente al Coordinador/a sobre desviaciones o situaciones que requieran intervención. Soportes de la gestión del fondo (meses 7 a 9) Recopilar y organizar los soportes de gasto de las iniciativas piloto (facturas, comprobantes, contratos y registros de pago), conforme a los requisitos definidos por el Especialista administrativo-financiero, la normativa tributaria ecuatoriana y los lineamientos de AECID. Verificar de forma preliminar que los soportes correspondan a las actividades y presupuestos aprobados. Alimentar la matriz de ejecución del fondo como insumo del informe administrativo de la gestión del fondo (Producto 4). Aportar retroalimentación sobre la aplicabilidad en campo de las fichas, matrices e instrumentos de seguimiento, como insumo para la caja de herramientas (Producto 5). We provide casino, sports betting, platform and payments, and affiliate management to 300 customers worldwide. But that's not all! We're not just about numbers, we're about people. With a team of over 1400 passionate individuals spread across twelve countries in Europe and Asia, we're all united by our love for innovation and teamwork. Join us on this exciting journey as we continue to redefine the iGaming landscape, one groundbreaking solution at a time. About UXMatrix UXMatrix develops a broad range of digital products, including bespoke frontend applications, reusable templates, widgets, APIs, automated quality-assurance solutions, and a fully customizable WordPress-based CMS. Our products serve multiple operators, brands, and regulated markets, requiring us to balance customer needs, end-user experience, technical scalability, regulatory requirements, and commercial value. About The Role We are looking for a Sportsbook Product Owner to join the UXMatrix Product Team and take ownership of the development and continuous improvement of our sportsbook frontend experience. You will define what should be built and why, translating customer, market, and business needs into clear product outcomes and actionable requirements for the development team. You will work closely with design, engineering, QA, delivery, sportsbook platform teams, commercial stakeholders, and operators throughout the complete product lifecycle—from discovery and definition through delivery, launch, measurement, and optimization. The ideal candidate combines strong product thinking with an understanding of sportsbook user journeys, frontend technology, data, and agile delivery. You should be comfortable making decisions, challenging assumptions, managing competing priorities, and maintaining a clear product direction in a fast-paced environment. What You'll get to do: Product Vision and Strategy Define and communicate the product vision, strategy, objectives, and roadmap for the sportsbook frontend. Translate company strategy, operator requirements, market trends, and end-user needs into clear product priorities. Identify opportunities to improve sportsbook acquisition, engagement, conversion, retention, and overall user experience. Balance reusable product capabilities with operator-specific and market-specific requirements. Contribute to the long-term evolution of the sportsbook product, including personalization, modularity, scalability, and multi-tenant capabilities. Clearly articulate the business and customer value behind proposed initiatives. Product Discovery and Requirements Work with operators, commercial teams, internal stakeholders, and end users to identify problems, needs, and product opportunities. Analyze sportsbook journeys such as event discovery, navigation, search, market selection, bet placement, betslip usage, live betting, promotions, and bet management. Convert business needs into clear product requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows, and functional specifications. Break down complex initiatives into manageable and independently deliverable increments. Validate requirements with design, engineering, QA, platform teams, and relevant stakeholders before development begins. Ensure regulatory, responsible-gambling, accessibility, localization, and market-specific requirements are considered during product definition. Maintain complete, accurate, and accessible product documentation in Jira and Confluence. Roadmap and Prioritization Own and continuously maintain the product backlog. Prioritize initiatives and backlog items based on customer value, user impact, commercial potential, strategic alignment, risk, effort, and technical dependencies. Define minimum viable product scope and phased-delivery approaches for larger initiatives. Manage scope throughout the delivery lifecycle and ensure material changes are assessed, documented, and agreed with the appropriate stakeholders. Balance new product development, operator requirements, technical improvements, defects, and technical-debt reduction. Make clear prioritization decisions when capacity or timelines are constrained. Agile Delivery Work closely with engineering, design, and QA throughout planning, refinement, development, testing, and release. Ensure the development team understands the product objectives, user needs, requirements, and expected outcomes. Lead or actively contribute to backlog refinement, sprint planning, reviews, and relevant product workshops. Provide timely clarification and make product decisions during development. Identify dependencies, risks, and blockers early and collaborate with the appropriate owners to resolve them. Accept completed work based on agreed requirements and acceptance criteria. Support release planning and ensure features are ready from a product, operational, documentation, and stakeholder perspective. Maintain delivery transparency and communicate progress, risks, scope changes, and decisions clearly. Stakeholder and Client Management Act as the primary product contact for assigned sportsbook initiatives. Build strong working relationships with operators, sportsbook platform teams, commercial stakeholders, engineering, UX, QA, delivery, and senior management. Facilitate product workshops, requirement-gathering sessions, demonstrations, and roadmap discussions. Set clear expectations regarding product scope, priorities, dependencies, and delivery assumptions. Evaluate stakeholder requests objectively and challenge solutions that do not support the product strategy or provide sufficient customer value. Present recommendations using evidence, product data, competitive analysis, and clearly structured business arguments. Support client presentations, product demonstrations, sales opportunities, and RFP responses when required. Product Performance and Continuous Improvement Define success criteria and measurable KPIs for new features and product initiatives. Monitor sportsbook metrics such as event-to-bet conversion, betslip completion, bet placement success, click-through rates, engagement, bet frequency, retention, and feature adoption. Use quantitative data, qualitative feedback, user research, and operational insights to evaluate product performance. Review delivered features after launch and identify opportunities for optimization. Work with UX and analytics teams to identify friction, abandonment points, usability issues, and unmet customer needs. Maintain awareness of sportsbook market developments, competitor products, user-experience patterns, and emerging technologies. Conduct competitor and feature-comparison analysis to identify meaningful product differentiators. Propose improvements that strengthen the UXMatrix sportsbook proposition and create measurable value for EveryMatrix clients. What we’re looking for: At least three years of experience in product ownership, product management, business analysis, or a comparable digital-product role. Experience in iGaming. Experience working with cross-functional software-development teams in an agile environment. Strong ability to translate business and user needs into clear, structured, and testable product requirements. Demonstrated experience managing product backlogs, priorities, scope, dependencies, and stakeholder expectations. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to make evidence-based product decisions. Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Confidence presenting product recommendations and reasoning with technical, commercial, and senior stakeholders. Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple initiatives and competing priorities. Ability to understand technical concepts, frontend architecture, APIs, integrations, and platform dependencies at a product level. Experience using Jira, Confluence, or equivalent product and delivery-management tools. Professional proficiency in English. A degree in technology, economics, business, or a related discipline. What Success Looks Like Success in this role means establishing a clear and evidence-based direction for the sportsbook frontend, maintaining a well-prioritized and delivery-ready backlog, improving collaboration between product and engineering, and delivering measurable improvements for operators and sportsbook users. You will be expected to create alignment around what we build, why we build it, and how we determine whether it has been successful. Here's what we offer: Start with 22 days of annual leave, with 2 additional days added each year, up to 32 days by your fifth year with us. Benefit from two Free Fridays each year, limited to one per quarter. 3 sick leave days per year, no doctor's note required. Daily catered lunch or monthly lunch allowance. Private Medical Subscription. Access online learning platforms like Udemy for Business and LinkedIn Learning, and a budget for external training. Access to an Employee Assistance Program through TELUS Health. Our office perks include parking, on-site massages, and frequent team-building activities in various locations. And did we mention our amazing office space complete with its own pool and gym? At EveryMatrix, we're committed to creating a supportive and inclusive workplace where you can thrive both personally and professionally. Come join us and experience the difference! EveryMatrix is a member of the World Lottery Association (WLA) and European Lotteries Association. In September 2023 it became the first iGaming supplier to receive WLA Safer Gambling Certification. EveryMatrix is proud of its commitment to safer gambling and player protection whilst producing market leading gaming solutions.
